First release for Solasta II Early Access build **CL-112340** (2026-09-10 patch).

**What it does:** up to 6 heroes in a new campaign and up to 6 players in a hosted lobby. Existing 4-hero saves are untouched and load exactly as vanilla. Includes the optional GiveSpellbook fix (multiclass-into-Wizard spellbook missing in multiplayer).

**Install:** unzip, close the game, run `BiggerParty-Installer.exe` (installs UE4SS if needed), start the game. Everyone in a session installs the same way. `u` in the installer uninstalls.

**Verified:** 6-hero single-player campaign (creation, party, HUD, combat, save/load), 6-seat lobby on the host. **Not yet verified:** a full 6-player online session — please report how it goes in Issues.

After a game patch the mod refuses to touch code it doesn't recognise and goes inert (see `BiggerParty.log`); your saves are safe either way.
